DLBR.name: Dialogue Branch
DLBR.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/DLBR. [measured: 3,061 of each of DNAM, QNAM, SNAM and TNAM in Skyrim.esm]

DLVW.name: Dialogue View
DLVW.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/DLVW. A dialogue view is a flowchart-like view of existing dialogues, and is strictly a user interface for creating and editing them. [measured: 1,126 QNAM, 1,120 DNAM and 1,112 ENAM fields in Skyrim.esm]

BNAM.name: Branches
BNAM.note: The dialogue branches (DLBR) the view uses. A view with branches appears to exclude it having topics.

DNAM.name: Show All Text
DNAM.note: Whether Show All Text is selected in the CK.

ENAM.name: Unknown
ENAM.note: Zero for a view with branches, and 7 for a view with topics.

QNAM.name: Parent Quest
QNAM.note: The QUST the view belongs to.

TNAM.name: Topics
TNAM.note: The dialogue topics (DIAL) the view uses. A view with topics appears to exclude it having branches.

IPDS.name: Impact Data Set
IPDS.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/IPDS. An impact data set is a paired list of material type and impact data. [measured: 11,636 PNAM fields in Skyrim.esm, each 8 bytes, which is one pair]

PNAM.name: Pair
PNAM.note: A material type and the impact data that goes with it. There is one pair per material.

LCRT.name: Location Reference Type
LCRT.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/LCRT. [measured: 404 CNAM fields in Skyrim.esm]

CNAM.name: Colour Code
CNAM.note: The RGB colour code. The last byte is always zero.

LVLI.name: Leveled Item
LVLI.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/LVLI. [measured: 3,056 LLCT fields in Skyrim.esm]

LVLN.name: Leveled NPC
LVLN.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/LVLN. [measured: 527 LLCT fields in Skyrim.esm]

LLCT.name: Entry Count
LLCT.note: How many entries the list has, which is the number of LVLO records.

LVLD.name: Chance For No Spawn
LVLD.note: The chance that an item on this list is not spawned at all. It is always zero, and does not appear in the CK.

LVLF.name: Flags
LVLF.note: 0x01 = All Levels, which sets it to calculate for every entry below the player level and choose randomly among them. 0x02 = Each, which repeats the check every time the list is called rather than reusing the result.

LVLO.name: Leveled Object
LVLO.note: The list's entries: the level, the NPC or LVLN the entry uses, and how many enemies it adds.

NAVM.name: Navmesh
NAVM.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/NAVM. The navmesh geometry is not documented field by field and is left opaque here. [measured: 15,966 NAVM records in Skyrim.esm, with NVNM running from 130 to 3,578 bytes]

NVNM.name: Navmesh Geometry
NVNM.note: The navmesh's geometry. The layout is not documented, so it is read as raw bytes.

OTFT.name: Outfit
OTFT.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/OTFT. [measured: 481 INAM fields in Skyrim.esm]

INAM.name: Inventory List
INAM.note: The outfit's pieces, which are ARMO or LVLI records. There is no count of its own, so it is a run of formids.

SNDR.name: Sound
SNDR.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/SNDR. A sound carries a descriptor, a category, its tracks and the conditions under which it plays. [measured: 4,951 ANAM tracks in Skyrim.esm, and the FNAM field is 4 bytes]

BNAM.name: Settings
BNAM.note: The sound's frequency, priority and attenuation.

CNAM.name: Sound Descriptor Type
CNAM.note: A CRC32 hash of the class name, for example "BGSStandardSoundDef". Bethesda uses a non-standard CRC.

CTDA.name: Conditions
CTDA.note: The conditions under which the sound plays.

LNAM.name: Settings
LNAM.note: The sound's flags and rumble level.

SNAM.name: Sound
SNAM.note: Another SNDR to take the sound from.

struct.name: biped_object_flags
struct.note: The biped object flags.

struct.name: general_flags
struct.note: The general flags.

struct.name: armor_type
struct.note: The armor type. Clothing is the default when it is not given.

struct.name: flags
struct.note: The cell's flags. The field is sometimes only one byte long. The Can't Travel From Here flag is only valid for interior cells.

struct.name: anchor
struct.note: The vertical reference, usually near the cell's terrain minimum.

struct.name: grid
struct.note: A 32 by 32 grid of per-quad height ceilings, column-major. The byte at index col * 32 + row covers the 128 by 128 game unit quad at (col, row), with col 0 the west edge and row 0 the south edge. Each byte is the maximum height for that quad above the anchor, and vanilla cells use roughly 110 game units per step. The terrain rendering does not use this; LAND's VHGT gives the ground geometry separately.

struct.name: x
struct.note: The cell's x coordinate in the grid.

struct.name: y
struct.note: The cell's y coordinate in the grid.

struct.name: flags
struct.note: The high bits look random.

struct.name: material
struct.note: The material type (MATT).

struct.name: impact
struct.note: The impact data (IPCT), which is generally the same for all the pairs.

struct.name: reference
struct.note: A REFR, usually to a STAT.

struct.name: delay
struct.note: The delay.

struct.name: fov_offset
struct.note: The field of view offset from the base object, in degrees.

struct.name: fade_offset
struct.note: The fade offset from the base object.

struct.name: end_distance_cap
struct.note: The end distance cap.

struct.name: shadow_depth_bias
struct.note: The shadow depth bias.

struct.name: unknown
struct.note: Four bytes that are not a float. Seen in Dawnguard and Hearthfire.

struct.name: keyword
struct.note: Zero, or a KYWD — usually LinkCarryStart or LinkCarryEnd.

struct.name: reference
struct.note: A REFR, usually to a STAT. FURN also appears here.

struct.name: level
struct.note: The lock's level: -1 requires a key, 0 is Novice, 25 is Apprentice, 50 is Adept, 75 is Expert and 100 is Master.

struct.name: flags1
struct.note: Flags, whose meaning is not known.

struct.name: key
struct.note: The KEYM record.

struct.name: flags2
struct.note: Flags, whose meaning is mostly not known.

struct.name: flags3
struct.note: Flags, whose meaning is not known.

struct.name: unused
struct.note: Zero.

struct.name: location_ref_type
struct.note: The LCRT record.

struct.name: frequency_shift
struct.note: The percentage frequency shift.

struct.name: frequency_variance
struct.note: The percentage frequency variance.

struct.name: priority
struct.note: The priority. The default is 128.

struct.name: db_variance
struct.note: The decibel variance.

struct.name: static_attenuation
struct.note: The static attenuation in decibels. The stored value is a hundred times the actual value.

struct.name: flags
struct.note: At most one of the looping flags can be set.

struct.name: unused
struct.note: Unused.

struct.name: rumble_send
struct.note: The rumble's send level. The small value is seven times the lower four bits and the big value seven times the upper four bits.

struct.name: unknown
struct.note: The world data's contents, whose layout is not documented.
